correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of all 2^20 edge subsets gives 37,440 faces and confirms purity. An explicit matching with 18,697 pairs has global acyclicity verified across all 217,580 incidences. Exactly one 0-cell, forty-two 6-cells and three 7-cells survive. The complete 42x3 signed integer Morse boundary is identically zero, using a terminating acyclic recursive reduction. The 6-skeleton has no lower-dimensional positive cells and is 5-connected; Hurewicz identifies the attaching maps with those zero degrees, proving the wedge. Independent raw mod-2 simplicial ranks agree.

originality.rationale: Published indexed neighboring higher-matching computations do not determine the K_(4,5) case. The primary readable Singh manuscript states explicit complete-bipartite homotopy theorems only for m>r>=n or balanced r=n-1, neither of which applies to r=2 and {m,n}={4,5}. Singh cites general rational homology, which does not imply the integral homotopy equivalence. The new clique-free manuscript announces sufficient shellability conditions for certain chordal graphs, while the line graph in question contains induced four-cycles. Multiple focused published-result searches and accessible historical claims found no same-statement or stronger covering theorem. Full-text access to the recent preprint was unsuccessful, and unindexed work remains a stated residual risk.
residual_risks: Full text and appendices of arxiv:2602.09623 were inaccessible, so unreported exact examples in that manuscript cannot be ruled out.
Reiner–Roberts original full text and possible supplementary tables were not inspected; rational Betti numbers may be old, though their cited theorem does not give the integral homotopy equivalence.
Unindexed computations, theses, and other alternate formulations may independently contain this finite result.

value.rationale: The natural K4,5 two-matching complex is the immediate unbalanced rectangular case beyond exact neighboring K4,4 and K3,5 calculations. Its full integral homotopy type is mixed-dimensional, unlike those earlier examples, and it disproves shellability of a pure seven-dimensional graph complex. The integer attaching map information goes beyond potentially known rational homology and forms a concrete test case for general higher-matching and clique-free structural theory.
